summary: Completed the final verification of the Run 3 interpretability smoke-test suite for the KUL LOSO Conformer pipeline. The implementation passed review after aligning methodological claims with executable behavior, preserving exploratory labeling for FFT-based ablations, and resolving the previous documentation and channel-ablation issues without introducing new blocking defects.
lessons: Ensure comments and documentation describe only what the implementation actually verifies.
Treat agreement with recorded reference metrics as behavioral consistency validation rather than checkpoint provenance verification.
Label inference-time FFT spectral ablations as exploratory analyses and avoid presenting them as validated physiological evidence.
Keep interpretability analyses within the scope of the validated evaluation protocol when drawing scientific conclusions.
Maintain synchronization between dynamically generated experiment outputs and downstream visualization logic.
Use baseline metric validation as an acceptance check before running downstream interpretability analyses.
Design helper utilities to handle empty inputs consistently if they may be reused beyond the current evaluation workflow.
Accept interpretability results only after documentation, implementation, and evaluation methodology are mutually consistent.
task: Run 3 Smoke Test Interpretability suite implementation - Final Attempt
